images.caption: Banjar Sultanate since 2010, under Sultan al-Mu'tasim Billah of Banjar. The sultan's power traditionally applies to areas colored dark green, while light green indicates areas that recognize the influence of the sultanate (South Kalimantan Province in general). After the restoration, the sultanate only has traditional (adat) influence, and no political influence.
